panels.title: Lanterns going out
keyPoses: Wide valley vista at dusk. Rows of small lantern dots along the hollow; three near ones visibly dark. Nia's hill silhouette at frame right with her wind-ribbon pole. Slow push in.

panels.title: The wind-cartographer
keyPoses: Nia on the hilltop, cloak lifting in gusts. She ties paper ribbons to her survey pole; each ribbon streams a different way, mapping the unseen wind. Medium shot, gentle pan following ribbons.

panels.title: The chart will not close
keyPoses: Close on Nia's charcoal wind-chart: swirling arrows that refuse to settle, all bending away from the high cairn. Her hand stills. Match-cut framing to her eyes.

panels.title: Run down to Yara
keyPoses: Night falls fast. Two more lanterns gutter out along the hollow road in a visual beat, one, then another. Nia runs downhill toward grandmother's house, lantern-light shrinking behind her.

panels.title: What the valley is owed
keyPoses: Inside Yara's lamplit house: walls of charts, a keeper's lantern burning blue-gold on the mantel. Yara, old and steady, studies Nia's chart and nods slowly. Warm interior, push in to the lantern.

panels.title: The keeper's lantern
keyPoses: Yara lifts the keeper's lantern down and sets it in Nia's hands. The flame leans toward Nia, then steadies. Two-shot, slow orbit feel via drifting camera.

panels.title: The forbidden chart
keyPoses: Yara unrolls the forbidden high chart: the gorge, the washed bridge, the cairn path marked in faded red. Her finger traces it; Nia copies the turns into her own small book. Overhead map shot.

panels.title: Threshold farewell
keyPoses: Threshold farewell at the door: Yara knots a storm-ribbon into Nia's scarf. The valley behind them is nearly dark now, a handful of lights. Nia steps out with the lantern. Wide, hold, then rise.

panels.title: The low valley
keyPoses: Nia picks through the misty low valley, lantern high, ribbons streaming sideways in crosswinds. Reeds bend in waves. Tracking shot beside her, leaves tumbling past.

panels.title: The mossback wakes
keyPoses: The moss grove: ancient stones furred green, breath-mist hanging. Two ember eyes open in the dark between roots. Ruel the mossback boar rises, huge, patient, antlered with lichen. Nia freezes. Slow push in.

panels.title: Tested and trusted
keyPoses: The testing: Ruel circles Nia, snuffling the lantern, the charts, her trembling hands. She holds the lantern steady and shows him her wind-chart instead of running. The great head lowers. Intimate circling camera.

panels.title: Across the gorge
keyPoses: The gorge crossing: broken bridge timbers jutting over black water far below. Ruel wades the ford with Nia on his back, lantern held high, spray bursting around his legs. Grand lateral sweep.

panels.title: What the storm takes
keyPoses: The storm slope: sleet slanting, Nia leading Ruel up switchbacks, lantern glass frosting. Her ribbons tear loose one by one and fly upward, toward the cairn. Diagonal upward tilt.

panels.title: A blue thread
keyPoses: The flame nearly dies: a brutal gust flattens the lantern flame to a blue thread. Nia cups it with both hands and her own breath, shielding it with her body. Extreme close-up on hands and flame.

panels.title: The wind changes its mind
keyPoses: The turn: the wind drops all at once and begins to push at Nia's back, uphill, toward the cairn. Snow lifts in guiding spirals. Ruel looks up the path and understands. Slow crane up.

panels.title: The last steps
keyPoses: Final steps to the cairn stones: a dark ring of unlit braziers around a tall empty cairn. Nia climbs the last steps alone, Ruel waiting below, lantern flame standing tall now. Processional push in.

panels.title: She returned one
keyPoses: The lighting: Nia touches the keeper's flame to the cairn bowl. Light blooms outward in a slow ring, braziers catching one by one around her. Her face, lit gold. Radiant slow bloom.

panels.title: The valley remembers
keyPoses: The rekindling wave: aerial view of Ember Hollow as lanterns relight in a rolling wave from the high cairn down to the last house. Tiny figures come to doors. Majestic pull-back.

panels.title: The keeper comes home
keyPoses: Coda at Yara's door at dawn: the old keeper watches the cairn light on the horizon and smiles. Nia's small figure descends the far path, new ribbons flying straight and true. Quiet two-plane parting shot.

panels.title: Hearthlight
keyPoses: Final frame: Nia on her hill at sunrise, keeper's lantern beside her, charting the morning wind with fresh ribbons. The valley glows below. Title card: HEARTHLIGHT. Slow fade to gold, hold, end.
